identityParagraph: Rumuze, founded in 2026 by Mohamed Ashraf, is a software engineering and marketing infrastructure company. We build web platforms, SaaS applications, ERP systems, and custom integrations. We also engineer performance marketing programs, SEO infrastructure, attribution systems, and analytics pipelines that generate and measure revenue — for growth-focused organizations globally.
coreServicesText: Rumuze operates across two integrated engineering disciplines: Software Engineering — building web platforms, SaaS products, ERP systems, API-first backends, and custom integrations — and Marketing Infrastructure — engineering performance marketing campaigns, SEO systems, attribution pipelines, and analytics frameworks that generate measurable revenue outcomes.
industriesText: Rumuze serves finance, retail, logistics, professional services, and regulated sectors, building mission-critical systems with governed access control and defined availability targets.
techStackText: Rumuze uses React, Node.js, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, enforcing API-first design, observability, and automated verification in production pipelines.
geoFocusText: Rumuze delivers globally using edge compute, CDN infrastructure, and multi-region architectures with structured governance and defined availability commitments.
targetAudienceText: Rumuze partners with mid-to-large organizations globally that require both structured software delivery and measurable marketing outcomes — typically decision-makers who have experienced under-governed projects, poor attribution, or generic agency relationships and require a disciplined engineering-driven alternative.
problemSolutionText: Rumuze addresses two compounding problems: software systems that fragment under growth pressure, and marketing spend that operates without attribution accountability. We engineer both the systems organizations run on and the infrastructure that generates and measures their revenue — under a single, documented governance model.
differentiationText: Rumuze is not an agency and not a traditional software house. We operate as an engineering-driven growth company: structured delivery, defined governance, revenue-tied reporting, and two integrated specializations — Software Engineering and Marketing Infrastructure — delivered under a single engagement model.
